ddl.name: agent_consents_identity
ddl.value: "identity" IS NULL OR (length("identity")=64 AND "identity" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')

ddl.name: operation_hashes
ddl.value: length("key_hash")=64 AND "key_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' AND length("fingerprint")=64 AND "fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'

ddl.name: environment_storage
ddl.value: ("secret"=1 AND "value" IS NULL AND "cipher" IS NOT NULL AND length("cipher") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384) OR ("secret"=0 AND "value" IS NOT NULL AND "cipher" IS NULL AND length("value")<=4096)
